profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Particular Software
profile.summary:
I'm a senior backend engineer, I love to code and technology, but the part that I love the most about my job is to be able to creatively solve problems. Sometimes the solution is to create a new piece of code and sometimes it is to track data on a spreadsheet. And I really enjoy that variability.
I see software development as an art form, where we as professionals enrich our solutions by sharing them with our peers, where we thrive by taking advantage of our constraints and where we are capable of being as creative as we want to.

I have a Bachelor degree in Computer Science from University of Chile. In college I learned about two major ways to develop software, waterfall and agile. I remember thinking that waterfall wasn't the right framework for me, as it was to rigid. The more I learned about agile methodologies and the whole philosophy behind them, the more enamored became with them, specially Kanban (I love Kanban). I really enjoy the focus that they put on the people and the embedded feedback loop on every iteration. That is how I became really active on the agile community in Chile, helping lead the Agile Day and leading some meetups. 

After taking some years off from work, working for mParticle was a great opportunity that helped me grow as a developer and made me feel confident about working on a 100% remote environment and on a different language (I'm a Spanish native speaker, and fluent in English).

Currently I'm open to work and looking for my next opportunity to bring joy to a great company.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: My most meaningful solo project during this period was to be able to redesign one of the main core services that supports the platform, by isolating one of its functionalities into a separated service.This task allowed me to deeply understand one of the most complex parts of the system and to be able to document it.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
mParticle is a CDP (customer data platform), meaning it is an application that allow its clients to merge their customer data from different sources into a consolidated profile.
As a software engineer on the Product Response team, I was in charge to design and implement new requested features and fix bugs, most of the time related to the third party integrations of the system.
My biggest project during this time period was to be part of the team that implemented a new role management system for the application.
Prior to this project, the options for roles where really limited (around 5 options) and global for all users, resulting on many customers having too many users with elevated permissions (most of the users where Administrators). 
After our implementation, our clients are able to create many custom roles and define the permissions as granulary as they need to.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and implementation of an end to end solution to expose data from an instance of Azure DataLake into a chat bot, allowing business analysts to have access to on demand granular data that wasn’t previously available to them.
